description: Gemini Flash API - pay per call, no API key. OpenAI-format chat completions on google/gemini-3.8-flash, pinned to Google AI Studio for reliability. This model spends hidden reasoning tokens even on simple prompts (measured: 385 reasoning tokens for a one-sentence summary) - pass max_tokens=500 or higher, or you may get an empty or truncated response. You sign a fixed price computed from your max_tokens; unused tokens are not refunded. 20s server-side timeout with an automatic 2nd-provider retry…

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens, capped at 4096 - also bounds the price ceiling.
